runs.final_sql:
SELECT drvr.drvr_rf
FROM qlfy
JOIN drvr ON qlfy.ref2 = drvr.drvr_id
WHERE qlfy.ref3 = 20
ORDER BY qlfy.q1 DESC
LIMIT 5
SELECT DISTINCT rcs.ref2 FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE crct.lctn = 'Shanghai'
SELECT rcs.url FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE crct.nm = 'Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya'

SELECT rcs.nm
FROM rcs
JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id
WHERE crct.cntr = 'Germany'

SELECT DISTINCT crct.lt, crct.lng
FROM cnstr
JOIN cnstr_rslt ON cnstr.cnst_id = cnstr_rslt.ref1
JOIN rcs ON cnstr_rslt.ref2 = rcs.rc_id
JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id
WHERE cnstr.nm = 'Renault'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2010 AND crct.cntr NOT IN ('Bahrain','Malaysia','China','Spain','Monaco','Turkey','United Kingdom','Germany','Hungary','Belgium','Italy','Singapore','Japan','Korea','United Arab Emirates')
SELECT rcs.nm FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE crct.cntr = 'Spain'
SELECT crct.lt, crct.lng FROM crct JOIN rcs ON crct.crct_id = rcs.ref1 WHERE rcs.nm = 'Australian Grand Prix'
SELECT rcs.url FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE crct.nm = 'Sepang International Circuit'
SELECT DISTINCT rcs.tm FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE crct.nm = 'Sepang International Circuit'
SELECT DISTINCT crct.lt, crct.lng FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE rcs.nm = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'

SELECT c.ntnl
FROM cnstr AS c
JOIN cnstr_rslt AS cr ON c.cnst_id = cr.ref1
WHERE cr.ref2 = 24 AND cr.pnts = 1
SELECT q1 FROM qlfy JOIN drvr ON qlfy.ref2 = drvr.drvr_id WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Bruno' AND drvr.srnm = 'Senna' AND qlfy.ref3 = 354
SELECT d.ntnl FROM qlfy q JOIN drvr d ON q.ref2 = d.drvr_id WHERE q.ref3 = 355 AND q.q2 = '0:01:40'
SELECT nmbr FROM qlfy WHERE ref3 = 903 AND q3 LIKE '1:54%'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rslt.ref3) FROM rcs JOIN rslt ON rcs.rc_id = rslt.ref4 WHERE rcs.nm = 'Bahrain Grand Prix' AND rcs.ref2 = 2007 AND rslt.tm IS NULL

SELECT ssn.url
FROM rcs
JOIN ssn ON rcs.ref2 = ssn.yr
WHERE rcs.rc_id = 901

SELECT COUNT(*) AS finished_drivers
FROM rslt r
JOIN rcs ra ON r.ref4 = ra.rc_id
WHERE ra.dt = '2015-11-29'
  AND r.tm IS NOT NULL

SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm
FROM rslt r
JOIN drvr d ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id
WHERE r.ref4 = 592 AND r.tm IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.db ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT d.url
FROM lp_tm l
JOIN drvr d ON d.drvr_id = l.ref1
WHERE l.ref2 = 161 AND l.tm LIKE '1:27%'

SELECT d.ntnl
FROM rslt r
JOIN drvr d ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id
WHERE r.ref4 = 933
ORDER BY CAST(r.fsts_lp_spd AS DECIMAL(10,3)) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT crct.lt, crct.lng FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE rcs.nm = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'
SELECT c.url FROM cnstr c JOIN cnstr_rslt cr ON c.cnst_id = cr.ref1 WHERE cr.ref2 = 9 ORDER BY cr.pnts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT q.q1
FROM qlfy q
JOIN drvr d ON q.ref2 = d.drvr_id
WHERE d.frnm = 'Lucas' AND d.srnm = 'di Grassi' AND q.ref3 = 345
SELECT d.ntnl FROM qlfy q JOIN drvr d ON q.ref2 = d.drvr_id WHERE q.ref3 = 347 AND q.q2 LIKE '1:15%'
SELECT d.cd FROM qlfy q JOIN drvr d ON q.ref2 = d.drvr_id WHERE q.ref3 = 45 AND q.q3 LIKE '1:33%'
SELECT rslt.mlls FROM rslt JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Bruce' AND drvr.srnm = 'McLaren' AND rslt.ref4 = 743

SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm
FROM rslt r
JOIN rcs rc ON r.ref4 = rc.rc_id
JOIN drvr d ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id
WHERE rc.nm = 'San Marino Grand Prix'
  AND rc.ref2 = 2006
  AND r.pstn = 2
SELECT ssn.url FROM rcs JOIN ssn ON rcs.ref2 = ssn.yr WHERE rcs.rc_id = 901

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM rslt
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE rcs.dt = '2015-11-29'
  AND rslt.tm IS NULL
SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm FROM rslt r JOIN drvr d ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id WHERE r.ref4 = 872 AND r.tm IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.db DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm FROM lp_tm l JOIN drvr d ON l.ref1 = d.drvr_id WHERE l.ref2 = 348 ORDER BY l.mlls ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT d.ntnl
FROM drvr d
JOIN rslt r ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id
ORDER BY CAST(r.fsts_lp_spd AS DECIMAL(10,3)) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT (CAST(r853.fsts_lp_spd AS DECIMAL(20,10)) - CAST(r854.fsts_lp_spd AS DECIMAL(20,10))) * 100 / CAST(r853.fsts_lp_spd AS DECIMAL(20,10))
FROM drvr d
JOIN rslt r853 ON r853.ref3 = d.drvr_id AND r853.ref4 = 853
JOIN rslt r854 ON r854.ref3 = d.drvr_id AND r854.ref4 = 854
WHERE d.frnm = 'Paul' AND d.srnm = 'di Resta'

SELECT COUNT(rslt.tm) / COUNT(rslt.ref3) AS completion_rate
FROM rslt
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE rcs.dt = '1983-07-16'
SELECT ref2 FROM rcs WHERE nm = 'Singapore Grand Prix' ORDER BY ref2 ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT nm FROM rcs WHERE ref2 = 2005 ORDER BY nm DESC
SELECT rcs.nm FROM rcs WHERE YEAR(rcs.dt) = YEAR((SELECT MIN(rcs2.dt) FROM rcs AS rcs2)) AND MONTH(rcs.dt) = MONTH((SELECT MIN(rcs3.dt) FROM rcs AS rcs3))
SELECT nm, dt FROM rcs WHERE ref2 = 1999 ORDER BY rnd DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ref2 FROM rcs GROUP BY ref2 ORDER BY MAX(rnd) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT r.nm FROM rcs AS r WHERE r.ref2 = 2017 AND r.ref1 NOT IN (SELECT r2.ref1 FROM rcs AS r2 WHERE r2.ref2 = 2000)

SELECT crct.cntr, crct.nm, crct.lctn
FROM rcs
JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id
WHERE rcs.nm = 'European Grand Prix'
ORDER BY rcs.ref2 ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT rcs.dt FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE crct.nm = 'Brands Hatch' AND rcs.nm = 'British Grand Prix' ORDER BY rcs.ref2 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rcs.ref2) FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE crct.nm = 'Silverstone Circuit' AND rcs.nm = 'British Grand Prix'

SELECT drvr.frnm, drvr.srnm FROM drvr_std JOIN drvr ON drvr_std.ref1 = drvr.drvr_id JOIN rcs ON drvr_std.ref2 = rcs.rc_id WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2010 AND rcs.nm = 'Singapore Grand Prix' ORDER BY drvr_std.pstn ASC

SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm, SUM(r.pnts) AS total_points
FROM drvr d
JOIN rslt r ON d.drvr_id = r.ref3
GROUP BY d.drvr_id, d.frnm, d.srnm
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm, r.pnts
FROM rcs rc
JOIN rslt r ON r.ref4 = rc.rc_id
JOIN drvr d ON d.drvr_id = r.ref3
WHERE rc.ref2 = 2017 AND rc.nm = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
ORDER BY r.pstn ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm, r.nm, l.mlls
FROM lp_tm l
JOIN drvr d ON d.drvr_id = l.ref1
JOIN rcs r ON r.rc_id = l.ref2
ORDER BY l.mlls ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(l.mlls) FROM lp_tm l JOIN drvr d ON l.ref1 = d.drvr_id JOIN rcs r ON l.ref2 = r.rc_id WHERE d.frnm = 'Lewis' AND d.srnm = 'Hamilton' AND r.nm = 'Malaysian Grand Prix' AND r.ref2 = 2009

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ds.pstn <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM drvr_std ds
JOIN drvr d ON ds.ref1 = d.drvr_id
JOIN rcs r ON ds.ref2 = r.rc_id
WHERE d.srnm = 'Hamilton' AND r.ref2 >= 2010

SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm, d.ntnl, MAX(ds.pnts) AS max_points
FROM drvr d
JOIN drvr_std ds ON d.drvr_id = ds.ref1
GROUP BY d.drvr_id, d.frnm, d.srnm, d.ntnl
ORDER BY MAX(ds.wns) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(db) AS age, frnm, srnm
FROM drvr
WHERE ntnl = 'Japanese'
ORDER BY db DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT crct.nm
FROM crct
JOIN rcs ON crct.crct_id = rcs.ref1
WHERE rcs.ref2 BETWEEN 1990 AND 2000
GROUP BY crct.crct_id, crct.nm
HAVING COUNT(*) = 4
SELECT crct.nm, crct.lctn, rcs.nm FROM crct JOIN rcs ON crct.crct_id = rcs.ref1 WHERE crct.cntr = 'USA' AND rcs.ref2 = 2006
SELECT rcs.nm AS race_name, crct.nm AS circuit_name, crct.lctn AS location FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE YEAR(rcs.dt) = 2005 AND MONTH(rcs.dt) = 9

SELECT DISTINCT rcs.nm
FROM drvr
JOIN rslt ON drvr.drvr_id = rslt.ref3
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Alex'
  AND drvr.srnm = 'Yoong'
  AND rslt.pstn < 20

SELECT SUM(drvr_std.wns) FROM drvr_std JOIN drvr ON drvr_std.ref1 = drvr.drvr_id JOIN rcs ON drvr_std.ref2 = rcs.rc_id JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Michael' AND drvr.srnm = 'Schumacher' AND crct.nm = 'Sepang International Circuit'
SELECT rcs.nm, rcs.ref2 FROM lp_tm JOIN drvr ON lp_tm.ref1 = drvr.drvr_id JOIN rcs ON lp_tm.ref2 = rcs.rc_id WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Michael' AND drvr.srnm = 'Schumacher' ORDER BY lp_tm.mlls ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(rslt.pnts) FROM rslt JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Eddie' AND drvr.srnm = 'Irvine' AND rcs.ref2 = 2000

SELECT rcs.nm, rslt.pnts
FROM drvr
JOIN rslt ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id
JOIN rcs ON rcs.rc_id = rslt.ref4
WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Lewis' AND drvr.srnm = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY rcs.ref2 ASC, rcs.rnd ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT rcs.nm, crct.cntr FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2017 ORDER BY rcs.dt ASC

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN crct.cntr = 'Germany' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) * 100 AS percentage
FROM rcs
JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id
WHERE rcs.nm = 'European Grand Prix'
SELECT lt, lng FROM crct WHERE nm = 'Silverstone Circuit'
SELECT nm FROM crct WHERE nm IN ('Silverstone Circuit', 'Hockenheimring', 'Hungaroring') ORDER BY lt DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT crct_rf FROM crct WHERE nm = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
SELECT cntr FROM crct ORDER BY alt DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drvr WHERE cd IS NULL
SELECT ntnl FROM drvr ORDER BY db ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT srnm FROM drvr WHERE ntnl = 'italian'
SELECT url FROM drvr WHERE frnm = 'Anthony' AND srnm = 'Davidson'
SELECT drvr_rf FROM drvr WHERE frnm = 'Lewis' AND srnm = 'Hamilton'
SELECT crct.nm FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2009 AND rcs.nm = 'Spanish Grand Prix'

SELECT DISTINCT rcs.ref2
FROM rcs
JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id
WHERE crct.nm = 'Silverstone Circuit'

SELECT rcs.url
FROM rcs
JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id
WHERE crct.nm = 'Silverstone Circuit'
SELECT rcs.tm FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2010 AND crct.lctn = 'Abu Dhabi'
SELECT COUNT(rcs.rc_id) FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE crct.cntr = 'Italy'
SELECT rcs.dt FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE crct.nm LIKE '%Barcelona-Catalunya%' ORDER BY rcs.dt
SELECT crct.url FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2009 AND rcs.nm = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
SELECT MIN(rslt.fsts_lp_tm) FROM rslt JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Lewis' AND drvr.srnm = 'Hamilton'
SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm FROM rslt r JOIN drvr d ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id WHERE r.fsts_lp_spd IS NOT NULL AND r.fsts_lp_spd <> '' ORDER BY CAST(r.fsts_lp_spd AS DECIMAL(10,3)) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT drvr.frnm, drvr.srnm, drvr.drvr_rf
FROM rslt
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id
WHERE rcs.nm = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND rcs.ref2 = 2007
  AND rslt.rnk = 1

SELECT rcs.nm
FROM drvr
JOIN rslt ON drvr.drvr_id = rslt.ref3
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Lewis' AND drvr.srnm = 'Hamilton'

SELECT rcs.nm
FROM drvr
JOIN rslt ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id
JOIN rcs ON rcs.rc_id = rslt.ref4
WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Lewis' AND drvr.srnm = 'Hamilton' AND rslt.rnk = 1

SELECT MAX(rslt.fsts_lp_spd)
FROM rslt
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE rcs.nm = 'Spanish Grand Prix' AND rcs.ref2 = 2009

SELECT DISTINCT rcs.ref2
FROM drvr
JOIN rslt ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id
JOIN rcs ON rcs.rc_id = rslt.ref4
WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Lewis' AND drvr.srnm = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY rcs.ref2

SELECT rslt.pstn_ordr
FROM rslt
JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Lewis'
  AND drvr.srnm = 'Hamilton'
  AND rcs.nm = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND rcs.ref2 = 2008
SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm FROM rslt r JOIN rcs ra ON r.ref4 = ra.rc_id JOIN drvr d ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id WHERE ra.ref2 = 1989 AND ra.nm = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND r.grd = 4
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rslt.ref3) FROM rslt JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2008 AND rcs.nm = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND rslt.tm IS NOT NULL

SELECT lt.tm
FROM lp_tm AS lt
JOIN drvr AS d ON lt.ref1 = d.drvr_id
JOIN rcs AS r ON lt.ref2 = r.rc_id
WHERE d.frnm = 'Lewis'
  AND d.srnm = 'Hamilton'
  AND r.nm = 'Australian Grand Prix'
  AND r.ref2 = 2008
ORDER BY lt.mlls ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT rslt.tm FROM rslt JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2008 AND rcs.nm = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND rslt.rnk = 2

SELECT drvr.frnm, drvr.srnm, drvr.url
FROM rcs
JOIN rslt ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
JOIN drvr ON drvr.drvr_id = rslt.ref3
WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2008
  AND rcs.nm = 'Australian Grand Prix'
  AND rslt.pstn = 1
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.drvr_id)
FROM rslt r
JOIN rcs ra ON r.ref4 = ra.rc_id
JOIN drvr d ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id
WHERE ra.ref2 = 2008
  AND ra.nm = 'Australian Grand Prix'
  AND d.ntnl = 'British'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rslt.ref3)
FROM rslt
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2008
  AND rcs.nm = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND rslt.tm IS NOT NULL
SELECT SUM(rslt.pnts) FROM rslt JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Lewis' AND drvr.srnm = 'Hamilton'

SELECT AVG(
  CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(rslt.fsts_lp_tm, ':', 1) AS DECIMAL(10,3)) * 60 +
  CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(rslt.fsts_lp_tm, ':', -1) AS DECIMAL(10,3))
) AS average_fastest_lap_time_seconds
FROM drvr
JOIN rslt ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id
WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Lewis'
  AND drvr.srnm = 'Hamilton'
  AND rslt.fsts_lp_tm IS NOT NULL
  AND rslt.fsts_lp_tm <> ''

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN rslt.tm IS NOT NULL THEN rslt.ref4 END) / COUNT(rslt.ref4) AS rate
FROM rslt
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2008 AND rcs.nm = 'Australian Grand Prix'

SELECT ROUND((last_result.mlls - champ.mlls) / last_result.mlls * 100, 2) AS percentage_faster
FROM (
  SELECT rslt.mlls
  FROM rslt
  JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
  WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2008
    AND rcs.nm = 'Australian Grand Prix'
    AND rslt.pstn = 1
    AND rslt.tm IS NOT NULL
  LIMIT 1
) AS champ,
(
  SELECT rslt.mlls
  FROM rslt
  JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
  WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2008
    AND rcs.nm = 'Australian Grand Prix'
    AND rslt.tm IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY rslt.pstn DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS last_result
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crct WHERE lctn = 'Adelaide' AND cntr = 'Australia'
SELECT lt, lng FROM crct WHERE cntr = 'USA'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drvr WHERE ntnl = 'British' AND YEAR(db) > 1980
SELECT MAX(cnstr_rslt.pnts) FROM cnstr_rslt JOIN cnstr ON cnstr_rslt.ref1 = cnstr.cnst_id WHERE cnstr.ntnl = 'British'
SELECT c.nm FROM cnstr c JOIN cnstr_std s ON c.cnst_id = s.ref1 ORDER BY s.pnts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT c.nm
FROM cnstr c
JOIN cnstr_rslt cr ON c.cnst_id = cr.ref1
WHERE cr.ref2 = 291 AND cr.pnts = 0

SELECT COUNT(cnstr_std.ref2)
FROM cnstr_std
JOIN cnstr ON cnstr.cnst_id = cnstr_std.ref1
WHERE cnstr.ntnl = 'Japanese' AND cnstr_std.pnts = 0
GROUP BY cnstr_std.ref1
HAVING COUNT(cnstr_std.ref2) = 2
SELECT DISTINCT c.nm FROM cnstr c JOIN cnstr_std cs ON cs.ref1 = c.cnst_id WHERE cs.pstn = 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cnst_id)
FROM cnstr c
JOIN rslt r ON r.ref2 = c.cnst_id
WHERE c.ntnl = 'French' AND r.lps > 50

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN rslt.tm IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100 AS completion_percentage
FROM rslt
JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE drvr.ntnl = 'Japanese' AND rcs.ref2 BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009

SELECT rcs.ref2 AS `year`,
       AVG(SUBSTR(rslt.tm,1,1)*3600 + SUBSTR(rslt.tm,3,2)*60 + SUBSTR(rslt.tm,6,2) + SUBSTR(rslt.tm,9)/1000) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM (
    SELECT rcs_final.ref2 AS champion_year, drvr_std.ref1 AS driver_id
    FROM drvr_std
    JOIN rcs rcs_final ON drvr_std.ref2 = rcs_final.rc_id
    JOIN (
        SELECT rcs_max.ref2 AS year_max, MAX(rcs_max.rnd) AS max_rnd
        FROM rcs rcs_max
        WHERE rcs_max.ref2 < 1975
        GROUP BY rcs_max.ref2
    ) final_race
      ON rcs_final.ref2 = final_race.year_max AND rcs_final.rnd = final_race.max_rnd
    WHERE drvr_std.pstn = 1
) champ
JOIN rslt ON rslt.ref3 = champ.driver_id
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id AND rcs.ref2 = champ.champion_year
WHERE rcs.ref2 < 1975
  AND rslt.tm IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY rcs.ref2

SELECT DISTINCT d.frnm, d.srnm
FROM drvr d
JOIN drvr_std ds ON d.drvr_id = ds.ref1
WHERE YEAR(d.db) > 1975 AND ds.pstn = 2
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT drvr.drvr_id) FROM drvr JOIN rslt ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id WHERE drvr.ntnl = 'Italian' AND rslt.tm IS NULL

SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm, r.fsts_lp_tm
FROM rslt r
JOIN drvr d ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id
WHERE r.fsts_lp_tm IS NOT NULL AND r.fsts_lp_tm <> ''
ORDER BY STR_TO_DATE(r.fsts_lp_tm, '%i:%s.%f') ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT rslt.fsts_lp
FROM rslt
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2009
  AND rslt.rnk = 1
  AND rslt.ref3 = (
    SELECT ds.ref1
    FROM drvr_std ds
    JOIN rcs r ON ds.ref2 = r.rc_id
    WHERE r.ref2 = 2009
      AND r.rnd = (SELECT MAX(rnd) FROM rcs WHERE ref2 = 2009)
      AND ds.pstn = 1
  )
SELECT AVG(CAST(rslt.fsts_lp_spd AS DECIMAL(10,3))) FROM rslt JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id WHERE rcs.nm = 'Spanish Grand Prix' AND rcs.ref2 = 2009
SELECT rcs.nm, rcs.ref2 FROM rcs JOIN rslt ON rcs.rc_id = rslt.ref4 WHERE rslt.mlls IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rslt.mlls ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN YEAR(d.dob) < 1985 AND r.lps > 50 THEN d.drvr_id END) / COUNT(d.drvr_id) * 100 AS percentage
FROM rslt r
JOIN rcs ra ON r.ref4 = ra.rc_id
JOIN drvr d ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id
WHERE ra.ref2 BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drvr JOIN lp_tm ON drvr.drvr_id = lp_tm.ref1 WHERE drvr.ntnl = 'French' AND (SUBSTR(lp_tm.tm,1,2)*60 + SUBSTR(lp_tm.tm,4,2) + SUBSTR(lp_tm.tm,7,2)/1000) < 120
SELECT cd FROM drvr WHERE ntnl = 'America'
SELECT rc_id FROM rcs WHERE ref2 = 2009
SELECT COUNT(ref1) FROM drvr_std WHERE ref2 = 18

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dutch_count
FROM (
    SELECT ntnl
    FROM drvr
    ORDER BY db DESC
    LIMIT 3
) AS youngest
WHERE ntnl = 'Dutch'
SELECT drvr_rf FROM drvr WHERE frnm = 'Robert' AND srnm = 'Kubica'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drvr WHERE ntnl = 'British' AND YEAR(db) = 1980

SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm
FROM drvr d
JOIN lp_tm lt ON lt.ref1 = d.drvr_id
WHERE d.ntnl = 'German'
  AND YEAR(d.db) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1990
GROUP BY d.drvr_id, d.frnm, d.srnm
ORDER BY MIN(lt.mlls) ASC
LIMIT 3
SELECT drvr_rf FROM drvr WHERE ntnl = 'German' ORDER BY db ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT drvr.drvr_id, drvr.cd
FROM drvr
JOIN rslt ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id
WHERE YEAR(drvr.db) = 1971
AND rslt.fsts_lp_tm IS NOT NULL

SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm
FROM drvr d
JOIN lp_tm l ON d.drvr_id = l.ref1
WHERE d.ntnl = 'Spanish' AND YEAR(d.db) < 1982
GROUP BY d.drvr_id, d.frnm, d.srnm
ORDER BY MAX(l.mlls) DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT r.ref2
FROM rslt AS res
JOIN rcs AS r ON res.ref4 = r.rc_id
WHERE res.fsts_lp_tm IS NOT NULL AND res.fsts_lp_tm <> ''
ORDER BY STR_TO_DATE(res.fsts_lp_tm, '%i:%s.%f') ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT rcs.ref2 FROM lp_tm JOIN rcs ON lp_tm.ref2 = rcs.rc_id ORDER BY lp_tm.mlls DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ref1 FROM lp_tm WHERE lp = 1 GROUP BY ref1 ORDER BY MIN(tm) DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rslt WHERE ref4 > 50 AND ref4 < 100 AND ref1 = 2 AND tm IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT lctn, lt, lng FROM crct WHERE cntr = 'Austria'
SELECT ref4 FROM rslt GROUP BY ref4 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT drvr.drvr_rf, drvr.ntnl, drvr.db
FROM qlfy
JOIN drvr ON qlfy.ref2 = drvr.drvr_id
WHERE qlfy.ref3 = 23
  AND qlfy.q2 IS NOT NULL

SELECT r.ref2 AS race_year, r.nm AS race_name, r.dt AS race_date, r.tm AS race_time
FROM drvr d
JOIN qlfy q ON q.ref2 = d.drvr_id
JOIN rcs r ON r.rc_id = q.ref3
WHERE d.drvr_id = (
    SELECT d2.drvr_id
    FROM drvr d2
    ORDER BY d2.db DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY r.dt ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.drvr_id) AS driver_count FROM drvr d JOIN rslt r ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id JOIN stat s ON s.stts_id = r.ref1 WHERE d.ntnl = 'American' AND s.stts = 'Puncture'

SELECT c.url
FROM cnstr AS c
JOIN cnstr_std AS cs ON c.cnst_id = cs.ref1
WHERE c.ntnl = 'Italian'
ORDER BY cs.pnts DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT c.url FROM cnstr_std cs JOIN cnstr c ON cs.ref1 = c.cnst_id ORDER BY cs.wns DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm
FROM drvr d
JOIN lp_tm lt ON d.drvr_id = lt.ref1
JOIN rcs r ON lt.ref2 = r.rc_id
WHERE r.nm = 'French Grand Prix' AND lt.lp = 3
ORDER BY lt.mlls DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT mlls FROM lp_tm WHERE lp = 1 ORDER BY tm ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(rslt.fsts_lp_tm) AS avg_fastest_lap_time
FROM rslt
JOIN rcs ON rcs.rc_id = rslt.ref4
WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2006
  AND rcs.nm = 'United States Grand Prix'
  AND rslt.rnk < 11

SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm
FROM drvr d
JOIN pt_stp p ON p.ref1 = d.drvr_id
WHERE d.ntnl = 'German'
  AND YEAR(d.db) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985
GROUP BY d.drvr_id, d.frnm, d.srnm
ORDER BY AVG(p.mlls) ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm, r.tm
FROM rcs rc
JOIN rslt r ON rc.rc_id = r.ref4
JOIN drvr d ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id
WHERE rc.ref2 = 2008
  AND rc.nm = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND r.pstn = 1

SELECT c.cnst_rf, c.url
FROM rcs r
JOIN rslt res ON res.ref4 = r.rc_id
JOIN cnstr c ON c.cnst_id = res.ref2
WHERE r.ref2 = 2009 AND r.nm = 'Singapore Grand Prix' AND res.pstn = 1
SELECT frnm, srnm, db FROM drvr WHERE ntnl = 'Austrian' AND YEAR(db) BETWEEN 1981 AND 1991
SELECT frnm, srnm, url, db FROM drvr WHERE ntnl = 'German' AND YEAR(db) BETWEEN 1971 AND 1985 ORDER BY db DESC
SELECT lctn, cntr, lt, lng FROM crct WHERE nm = 'Hungaroring'

SELECT SUM(cnstr_rslt.pnts) AS score, cnstr.nm, cnstr.ntnl
FROM cnstr_rslt
JOIN cnstr ON cnstr_rslt.ref1 = cnstr.cnst_id
JOIN rcs ON cnstr_rslt.ref2 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE rcs.nm = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
  AND rcs.ref2 BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY cnstr.cnst_id, cnstr.nm, cnstr.ntnl
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(rslt.pnts) AS avg_score FROM rslt JOIN drvr ON rslt.ref3 = drvr.drvr_id JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id WHERE drvr.frnm = 'Lewis' AND drvr.srnm = 'Hamilton' AND rcs.nm = 'Turkish Grand Prix'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ref2 BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 10 AS annual_average_races FROM rcs
SELECT ntnl FROM drvr GROUP BY ntnl ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT wns FROM drvr_std WHERE pnts = 91
SELECT rcs.nm FROM rcs JOIN rslt ON rcs.rc_id = rslt.ref4 WHERE rslt.fsts_lp_tm = (SELECT MIN(rslt.fsts_lp_tm) FROM rslt)
SELECT crct.nm, crct.lctn, crct.cntr FROM rcs JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id ORDER BY rcs.dt DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT drvr.frnm, drvr.srnm FROM qlfy JOIN rcs ON qlfy.ref3 = rcs.rc_id JOIN crct ON rcs.ref1 = crct.crct_id JOIN drvr ON qlfy.ref2 = drvr.drvr_id WHERE crct.nm = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND rcs.ref2 = 2008 AND qlfy.q3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY qlfy.q3 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm, d.ntnl, r.nm
FROM drvr d
JOIN rslt rs ON rs.ref3 = d.drvr_id
JOIN rcs r ON r.rc_id = rs.ref4
WHERE d.drvr_id = (
  SELECT drvr_id
  FROM drvr
  ORDER BY db DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY r.dt ASC, r.rnd ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS accidents
FROM rslt
JOIN rcs ON rslt.ref4 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE rcs.nm = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND rslt.ref1 = 3
GROUP BY rslt.ref3
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(r.rslt_id) AS wins, d.frnm, d.srnm
FROM drvr d
LEFT JOIN rslt r ON r.ref3 = d.drvr_id AND r.pstn = 1
WHERE d.db = (SELECT MIN(db) FROM drvr)
GROUP BY d.drvr_id, d.frnm, d.srnm
SELECT MAX(drtn) FROM pt_stp

SELECT MAX(pt_stp.drtn)

SELECT pt_stp.lp

JOIN rcs ON pt_stp.ref2 = rcs.rc_id
WHERE rcs.ref2 = 2011 AND rcs.nm = 'Australian Grand Prix'

SELECT lp_tm.tm

JOIN drvr ON lp_tm.ref1 = drvr.drvr_id

ORDER BY lp_tm.mlls ASC

SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm

SELECT lp_tm.tm

LIMIT 1

SELECT rslt.fsts_lp_tm

JOIN crct c ON r.ref1 = c.crct_id
WHERE c.cntr = 'Austria' AND l.mlls IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY l.mlls ASC
LIMIT 1
